title: Lyceum Project Leaders Talk Corporate Funding and AI in Education
hook_text: Harvard faculty debated corporate AI funding.
script:
Harvard professors and members of the Lyceum Project discussed corporate funding and AI in education.
The Lyceum Project is an interdisciplinary initiative integrating artificial intelligence and philosophy to bring together academics and practitioners.
Event participants faced questions about the role companies should play in funding interdisciplinary AI research.
Speakers discussed how Aristotelian values can guide conversations about AI and how AI shapes our conception of excellence.
Would you want private companies funding university AI research projects?
